summary: The canonical OpenAPI Factory component graph still contains OpenAPI-only keywords and $ref/description sibling combinations that the restricted fail-closed converter profile rejects. Factory schema staging therefore records these concrete B16 gaps and continues emitting the legacy ref-materialization projection until B16 closes parity without broadening the profile.

blockingCategories.why: The fail-closed profile only accepts the documented core, composition/nullable, and internal reference keyword surface. OpenAPI documentation extensions, generator hints, and example payloads are intentionally rejected rather than copied into Draft 2020-12 output.

blockingCategories.pattern: $ref with sibling keywords such as description
blockingCategories.why: The refs/fail-closed profile requires $ref-only schema objects for internal component references. The authored Factory graph still annotates many property refs with description siblings that the legacy staging rewrite preserved.

legacyProjectionSemanticGaps.why: Legacy staging copied OpenAPI nullable keywords verbatim. The restricted profile converts supported primitive nullable forms into Draft 2020-12 type unions once the blocking categories above are closed.
